'''Nattle''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Logistics officer/Legends|logistics officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he was stationed on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] where he managed the sales of [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]].
